title: A dual-locked cyclopeptide–siRNA conjugate for tumor-specific gene silencing
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,73-80
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00247D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chen Li, Shuaishuai Sun, Hao Kong, Xiangqian Xie, Gaolin Liang, Yan Zhang, Huan Wang, Jinbo Li
A dual-locked cyclopeptide–siRNA conjugate (DPRC) with a tandem-responsive cleavable linker was prepared. After cyclopeptide-guided tumor homing, the DPRC was sequentially activated by glutathione (GSH) and light to release siRNA for gene silencing.
